description: Build an in-memory index and observe how many documents it holds. A document has an integer identifier field plus one or more text fields. Adding a document increases the document count by one; adding a document whose identifier is already present leaves the count unchanged (no duplicate). The index can also report the sorted list of identifiers it currently holds. Each action emits one line: 'size=<count>' or 'docs=<comma-separated sorted identifiers>'.
